rv.q: It’s a tale as old as – well, last Christmas. And the one before that, and the one before that, too. Raymond Briggs’ iconic 1978 picture book was animated for the screen in 1982, with a score by Howard Blake, before becoming a hit stage show in 1993. It’s been produced by Birmingham Rep every year since.
For new audience members, young and old, it is a production full of surprises, gentle humour and charm.
